base_row.description: Spectrum DCT38M-SDM 38" Side Discharge and Mulch Lawn Tractor with Manual Drive
base_row.marketingText: Spectrum DCT38M-SDM Manual Gear SIDE DISCHARGE AND MULCH Lawn Tractor Tackle your lawn with speed, precision, and comfort using the Spectrum DCT38M-SDM Lawn Tractor. Expertly engineered yet surprisingly affordable, this high-performance machine combines powerful features with ease of use, making it ideal for large lawns, rough-grass areas, or complex landscapes. Powered by a robust 452cc air-cooled engine, the DCT38M-SD delivers reliable performance and effortless cutting. Its manual gears can be changed effortlessly, allowing smooth acceleration and deceleration in both forward and reverse. The seven-position cutting height, easily adjusted via a conveniently placed lever, ensures perfect results across varying grass conditions. Meanwhile, large 457mm drive tyres provide excellent traction without damaging your lawn, and a tight 140cm turning circle makes sharp turns simple, saving you time at the end of each pass. Designed for convenience, the DCT38M-SD includes a deck-mounted hosepipe attachment for effortless undercarriage cleaning and a mulch plug for natural turf fertilisation and enhanced lawn health. Its generous 98cm cutting width makes light work of areas up to approximately 6,000m². Would you rather have a collection machine? No problem! Check out our Spectrum DCT38H! Now, why not take a scroll all the way to the bottom of this page to see some great 'add-on' ideas? With so many tractors available, it's easy to get lost in the options. That's why the DCT38 range makes the decision simple. Built to deliver dependable performance and long-lasting quality, these tractors go a step further with enhanced specifications that outperform many competitors in the same class. For power, durability and overall value, the DCT38 range represents a smart, future-proof choice. To maintain warranty validity, annual servicing from year two onwards by an authorised dealer is required. N.B this machine arrives boxed for home assembly. Please call the office for prices of assembly or if you require an express delivery on.
